name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: In the Undercity, Tanis Alderwood asks you for fresh cloth. His wife is falling apart, and he hopes to wrap her until an apothecary is free.

sections.title: A Beggar's Plea
sections.body: The apothecaries are occupied with the Dark Lady's business. So Tanis asks you to bring linen for his wife. He hopes the cloth will hold her together while they wait for help.

faq.answer: Tanis Alderwood, a beggar in the Undercity, asks you to help his wife.
Tanis says she is literally falling apart and needs a wrapping to hold her together.
Tanis says the apothecaries are occupied with the Dark Lady's business.
Tanis asks you to bring fresh cloth so he can wrap his wife while they wait for the apothecaries.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
